meshy.note: Smart Topology generates directly at target_polycount (no remesh pass); base colour only, no PBR maps.

units: Metres after skinning: the Armature root node carries scale 0.01 and the bones/inverse bind matrices are in centimetres, so the character stands 1.7 tall in world units. (The raw mesh accessor min/max are NOT the on-screen size.)
orientation: Y up. Character faces +Z. Feet on y=0, origin between the feet.

reference_image.prompt: Use the attached image only as the art-style reference (same stylized 3D CGI look, smooth slightly clay-like surfaces, bright saturated toy-like colours, same character proportions). Create a NEW single-character turnaround reference for 3D modelling: ONE Union infantry private from the 1860s, alone, front view, facing the camera straight on, standing in a neutral symmetrical A-pose: both arms straight and held about 35 degrees away from the body, EMPTY open hands with chunky fingers spread slightly, palms toward the thighs, legs straight and slightly apart, feet flat. Full body visible from the top of the hat to the soles of the boots, centred, with margin all around. He is top-heavy and stout: broad chest, thick forearms, oversized chunky hands, sturdy black boots, big head, thick sculpted eyebrows, prominent nose, bushy brown walrus moustache, confident grin. Clean simplified uniform in soft wool: royal blue coat with a row of brass buttons, sky-blue trousers, black boots, navy blue kepi cap with a plain brass button, two white leather cross-belts across the chest and a white waist belt with a plain brass buckle. No weapon, no backpack, no bedroll, no bag, nothing held, nothing on the back. Plain pure white background, flat even studio lighting, no ground, no cast shadow, no other objects, no text, no flag, no insignia lettering. Family-friendly comic tone, not a real person.

idle.note: Ready stance with the arms held away from the body (left arm forward), subtle breathing loop.

run.note: Hunched charge with both hands in front as if carrying a rifle; in place.

fire.source: Meshy Text to Motion (POST /openapi/v1/text-to-motion, mode prime) retargeted with POST /openapi/v1/animations motion_task_id
fire.motion_prompt: A soldier stands upright with feet planted shoulder-width apart, raises a long rifle to his right shoulder with both hands, aims straight ahead, fires once with a sharp recoil kick, then lowers the rifle back to a ready stance in front of his chest. He stays facing forward and his feet stay in place.
fire.note: Standing, facing +Z, both hands held up in front of the upper chest as if shouldering a long gun, then lowered. Starts already in the aim pose; one-shot, not a loop. Used as anim_fire because no library action is a standing forward rifle shot.

fire_kneel.note: Library action closest to a rifle shot. Starts and ends kneeling and aims off to the side rather than straight ahead, so it is saved only as an extra.

death.note: One-shot. Has root motion: the body ends lying about 1 m behind the start (-Z).

idle_calm.note: Relaxed upright stand, feet about 0.21 m apart (anim_idle is 0.45 m), very subtle side-to-side weight sway (head moves about 1 cm). Closes exactly.

march.note: Brisk upright purposeful walk in place, chest out, two steps per 1.13 s cycle, hips face straight ahead.

panic.note: Fast run in place with high back-kick and a lot of torso twist (about 43 degrees of hip yaw). A plain fast run: the scared look would have to come from the arms.

death_forward.note: One-shot. Doubles over, drops to the knees, then tips forward and ends curled on the side/front. Root motion: hips end about 0.9 m ahead (+Z) of the start; the game pins hips x/z so it plays in place.

hit.note: One-shot heavy hit: torso twists away, then folds deeply at the waist (head drops to about 1.1 m at 0.8 s) and recovers to the exact start pose by about 1.45 s. Starts and ends in a side-on guard stance (hips yawed about 46 degrees, feet staggered), not the idle stance.

stab.note: One-shot two-handed forward jab with a lunge step, returns to the exact start pose. Long wind-up: the thrust lands at about 1.75 to 2.2 s of 3.5 s. Starts side-on (hips yawed about 62 degrees). The hips step about 0.44 m forward and back; the game pins hips x/z.

cheer.note: Both arms raised with a small knee bounce and back arch; closes exactly. The cheer is carried by the arms, so arm IK has to be off for it to read.

kneel.action_name: Kneel on One Knee and Stand
kneel.note: One-shot: stands, then goes down on one knee and ends kneeling, torso hunched and head bowed, one hand toward the ground. Nearly still for the first 0.9 s.
kneel.edited: The library only has the opposite direction (kneeling, then standing up). This file is that clip REVERSED in time, with the hips track shifted so the first (standing) key sits at world x=0, z=-0.055. Play it backwards to stand up again. Kneeling end pose sits about 0.15 m left and 0.19 m behind the start (the game pins hips x/z).

knockback.note: One-shot: thrown up and backward off the feet (hips rise to about 1.5 m at 0.5 s), flips legs-up, lands flat on the back at about 1.0 s with arms spread, then settles. Lands about 0.63 m behind the start (-Z); the game pins hips x/z.
knockback.edited: The library clip starts 1.24 m behind and 0.2 m to the side of the origin; the hips track was shifted so the first key sits at world x=0, z=-0.055. Motion otherwise untouched.

hit_light.note: EXTRA, not asked for: a shorter, lighter flinch (ducks the head and crunches forward, feet planted) that returns to the exact start pose. Same side-on guard stance as anim_hit, so the two swap cleanly. Rename to anim_hit.glb if the heavy one is too much.

animation_files_note: Each anim_*.glb is a full copy of the skinned, textured character with one clip; all share the same skeleton as u_line.glb.
unused_free_clips: The rigging task also returned basic walking_man and running clips (in place, looping) at no extra cost; raw copies are in the scratchpad at meshy_work/downloads/u_line/rig/.
